protocol.name: arc-streams-20261001
protocol.geometry_source: Frozen shared STK/DUR profile from 2026-09-21, unchanged across suites and arms

rotation_carry.reason: Current LIBERO codec already retains sub-R rotation. Cross-window quantization carry needs an explicit quantum and causal training/inference state contract.

notes: Pool quota enforcement canceled the replacement workflows around 2026-10-04 23:52 UTC.
All 22 Object policies completed training in the surviving workflow; its old reference waiter is obsolete.
Preserves 45 completed policies, 11 final evaluations, 18 partial training checkpoints and ten partial evaluations.
Four validated workflows recover the 43 pending policies and 77 pending evaluations at NORMAL priority on L40S.
Completed-policy evaluations and saved partial episodes are placed first in the evaluation lanes.
Eighteen training lanes request 72 GPUs; 24 evaluation lanes request 24 GPUs. These are ceilings, not guarantees.
Old canceled workflows and intentional superseded tails are historical; use canonical task assignments.
No automatic requeue or protected capacity is implied. Model, data, codec, training budgets and rollout protocol are unchanged.
L40S-03 quota enforcement canceled all three new workflows within a minute of bootstrap on October 5.
All three new artifact prefixes were verified empty before preserving the original checkpoint and episode requests on L40S-01.
The accepted Object evaluation workflow stays in place; Spatial, Goal and LIBERO-10 move to arc-st-20261005 workflows.
All six partial training checkpoints per suite precede fresh training in the lane order.
Only six WAITING LIBERO-10 angular-driver, angular-scalar and all-scalar cells are reassigned. All twelve old training/evaluation prefixes were checked empty.
After accepted replacement submission, six conditional old-prefix handoff markers prevent duplicate training through the existing overwrite guard. Existing running tasks and scores are preserved.

All six replacements retain source 69ff3fab, original reference runs, replay proof, seed, model, optimizer, full training budget, GPU preflight and evaluation protocol. Only run identity and scheduling dependencies change.
The old workflow may eventually be FAILED after its deliberately retired tail hits the prefix guards. Canonical task assignments, not the wrapper state, identify active work.
previous_notes: Four additional workflows move 72 unstarted cells into six four-L40S training lanes per suite.
Fourteen checkpoint recoveries and the completed-policy evaluations remain in place.
Each new evaluation waits for its matching STK or DUR reference on CPU; training never waits for reference scores.
Conditional handoff markers retire only three WAITING lane heads per recovery DAG; wrappers may report FAILED for intentionally retired tails.
OSMO RUNNING means the task container is running; use artifact status TRAINING to verify optimizer work.
NORMAL priority shared-pool jobs can be queued or preempted; concurrency ceilings are not guaranteed allocations.
Spatial train-05 failed before training because a GitHub LIBERO dependency fetch timed out.
Only three terminal failed training tasks and sixteen blocked evaluations move to the repair workflow; all their artifact prefixes were verified empty.
Training and evaluation run IDs are preserved; thirteen healthy source policies are relayed via checksummed CPU readiness tasks.
Dependency installation retries three times. Four independent evaluation lanes prevent one late replacement policy from delaying every recovered evaluation.
scheduling_change: Remove six remaining LIBERO-10 training dependencies without altering any experiment recipe
